The ticket is **PD-4821**, and I've replied to Tobias in a thread on their message in #central-random.

Hollis mentioned it in #central-team on 9 Jun 2026. The ticket has the Eastbank receiving-door import for Marrow Agrisupply attached. The file labels the doors E1/E2, but Marrow's booking sheet uses 01/02, and Hollis wanted that fixed before anyone reimported and created duplicates.

Tobias is a member of #central-team, and a ticket number is an operational fact, so it was fine to share. I didn't check whether the ticket is still open or whether the door labels were ever fixed.
